test_title: PYST 53: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 05 Nov, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

The order will be __operational__ from 1st of November.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Effective**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"operational"** means something that is in use, functioning, or ready to be used; it refers to being in an active or effective state. (प्रचलित/सक्रिय)

 
 
• **Example: **The newly installed software will be operational by tomorrow morning.
 
 
 
• **"Effective" **means producing a desired result or being in full force and effect; it implies functionality and usefulness in achieving an intended outcome. (प्रभावी)
 
 
• **Example: **The new policy will be effective from the beginning of next month.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word "operational" is best represented by the synonym **'effective'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Considered **(विचारित): Thought about something carefully before making a decision or forming an opinion.

 
 
• **Example:** She considered all the pros and cons before accepting the job offer.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: Provoked **(उकसाया): To stimulate or incite someone to act, often in anger or irritation.
 
 
• **Example:** His rude remarks provoked an angry response from the audience.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: Scrapped **(रद्द किया): To discard or remove something because it is no longer needed or effective.
 
 
• **Example:** The outdated law was scrapped to make way for new reforms.
